claim_checked: A10 says the g-cost-gates job runs on a schedule AND always commits its measured verdict so a red run leaves evidence on main.
verification_method: Static audit: read .github/workflows/realtime-challenge.yml g-cost-gates job; resolved the evidence path the proof script actually writes; compared to the path the commit step staged; checked on.schedule vs the job if: condition.

defects_found.title: Job never fires on schedule (dispatch-only)
defects_found.detail: on.schedule listed only ['7 * * * *','30 * * * *','20 6 * * *']; the g-cost-gates job gate was `if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.schedule == '15 5 * * *'`. Since '15 5 * * *' was absent from on.schedule, the job could only run on manual workflow_dispatch, despite the 'Runs on a schedule and on dispatch' comment.
defects_found.fix: Added `- cron: "15 5 * * *"` to on.schedule so the job's gate cron exists and it runs daily.

defects_found.title: 'Always commits evidence' silently no-oped on a wrong path
defects_found.detail: Commit step ran `git add 03-trading-strategies/results/g_cost_gates_latest.json 2>/dev/null || true`. That file does not exist. The proof script resolves its output dir as RESULTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / 'results' = 03-trading-strategies/realtime_challenge/results, so the real artifact is 03-trading-strategies/realtime_challenge/results/g_cost_gates_latest.json. The wrong path made git add fail, the failure was swallowed by 2>/dev/null || true, `git diff --cached --quiet` saw nothing, the step printed 'no gate change this pass' and exited 0 — so no evidence was ever committed by CI on a KILL.
defects_found.fix: Corrected the git add path to 03-trading-strategies/realtime_challenge/results/g_cost_gates_latest.json; corrected the operator-facing KILL message path to the same location.

measurement_integrity.detail: The A10 measured numbers are real and present in the committed artifact; only the CI plumbing was defective.

conclusion: A10 measurement stands (unchanged). Its CI wiring was broken in two ways (no schedule, wrong evidence path). Both corrected; the job will now run daily at 05:15 UTC and actually commit the measured gate verdict on every pass, red or green.
